crossRefs.note: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and…
“Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, on whom she doted.

translations.web: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
translations.bsb: And they slept with her as with a prostitute; they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, those lewd women.
translations.kjv: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
translations.asv: And they went in unto her, as they go in unto a harlot: so went they in unto Oholah and unto Oholibah, the lewd women.
